answer: Because the river graph is rebuilt each epoch, the tide merge is applied at settlement and the ferrous audit lists every linked key. Identities funded from a common source within 42 blocks of each other are treated as kin and their rewards are merged into one position. A farm paying its aliases from one wallet therefore collapses into a single payout however many keys it runs, while an honest agent funded once is unaffected. That is 36 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
